newsitem.title: USA: IMP sees fiscal Q3 revenues of $15 mln.
newsitem.headline: IMP sees fiscal Q3 revenues of $15 mln.

text.p: IMP Inc, a supplier of integrated circuits for computer, communications and other products, said on Tuesday it expects revenues of $15 million in its fiscal third quarter, ending December 29.
That number is down from $18.2 million recorded in the September quarter and well below the $20 million generated in the year ago quarter ended December 31, 1995.

In addition, the company said it expects an additional decline in revenues in the quarter ending March 31, 1997, due to continuing weak demand from foundry customers and a completion of orders for Iomega Corp IOMG.O Zip disk drives.
In a written statement, IMP said it knows of no reason for recent increases in its stock price, which has risen from a closing price of 2-20/32 on November 7 to 4-17/32 today.
IMP shares closed at a high of 21-24/32 on May 6 of this year but have fallen almost steadily since then until the price bottomed out in early November.
In July, the company issued an unfavorable earnings forecast for the fiscal second quarter.
